messages:
maya (Docs): opened a concise preflight guide PR for private/onprem installs focused on networking, HSM cert bundles, and offline mirrors. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5079 :wave:

nate (Installer): quick skim - looks useful. could we add a minimal troubleshooting subsection for 'stalled image pulls' when mirror auth fails? a one-liner and example journalctl would help QA.

anya (Security): Security review: add explicit guidance for validating HSM certificate chains when using vendor-supplied PKCS#11 modules. recommend commands and a note about verifying cert fingerprints out-of-band. Also remind customers to pin TLS cipher suite to TLS1.2+ modern ciphers.

fred (PrivOps): added a small example for verifying HSM cert chain:```bash
# verify chain
openssl x509 -in vendor-hsm-ca.pem -noout -fingerprint
openssl verify -CAfile vendor-hsm-ca.pem device-cert.pem
```

maya (Docs): perfect. i'll add that snippet and a short note about storing vendor CA in /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors for RHEL-family.

nate (Installer): for networking: suggestion to include two conversion snippets: nftables -> iptables-legacy MASQUERADE rule, and the reverse. many customers run older distros.

maya (Docs): adding both conversions + a compact port table for control-plane, installer, kms (TCP 443), hsm (TCP 12345), image-mirror (TCP 5000). keeping it one small table so it fits the preflight checklist.

doc-lint-bot: link-check: 1 broken link detected (/internal/hsm-cert-guidance -> 404). Please update or point to /docs/security/hsm-cert-verify.

anya (Security): also call out SELinux labels for PKCS#11 libs on rhel and systemd unit TimeoutStartSec=300 for slow devices during image imports.

fred (PrivOps): tested the offline mirror auth flow with token-file auth; adding example config for cri-o and containerd. both were added to PR as tiny snippets.

nate (Installer): added the 'stalled image pulls' troubleshooting note: check registry auth file permissions and journalctl -u registry-proxy. short one-liner included in PR.

maya (Docs): pushed updates: HSM cert verify commands, distro CA path note, nftables/iptables conversions, port table, SELinux label mention, TimeoutStartSec change, and stalled-pull troubleshooting. replaced broken link to /docs/security/hsm-cert-verify. tagging @anya @nate for quick review.

anya (Security): approved after I confirmed the cert verify steps and SELinux callout.

nate (Installer): +1 from install team. thanks for keeping it compact.

maya (Docs): merged. following up with a short note in the migration guide about customers switching from iptables-legacy to nftables and what to watch for during upgrades :tada:
